description: GOV-400 inventory of fonts that third-party code compiles into SparkEngine binaries (they ship inside executables and libraries, not as font files). Keys are the names the embedding code gives each font; the same string is compiled into every binary that carries the font, and cmake/PackageNoticeCoverageRules.json 'embeddedFonts.markers' must list exactly these keys (Tests/Tools/test_third_party_notices.py enforces it) so the staged-package gate finds them. 'sources' names, per ThirdParty/dependencies.lock component, the source files that embed font data; tools/governance/generate_third_party_notices.py scans them and requires every '[SECTION] Default font data (...)' declaration to have an entry whose 'source_section' names it, whose declaration lines are reproduced verbatim in 'license_file' (a file in ThirdParty/Licenses), whose 'copyright' and 'license' appear in that declaration, and whose key is a string literal in the source.

ProggyClean.ttf.license_source: Declaration in ThirdParty/UI/imgui/imgui_draw.cpp section 'Default font data (ProggyClean.ttf)'; upstream https://github.com/bluescan/proggyfonts
